title: SebasMusic
description: songs with a command in Minecraft
body:
# WELCOME TO SEBASMUSIC

**¿What is sebasmusic?**
SebasMusic is a mod that allows you to put songs in Minecraft, only is for songs that includes but if you want to suggest a song you can do it in Discord **->** [DISCORD LINK](https://discord.gg/Rmr3VGCvUJ). The mod only works in multiplayer servers, you can use the command if you are OP PLAYER. You can use in survival activating the allow commands option.

FORUMS:

![Forum to suggest music](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f67b2e94f3d1d1da6f8833da45ac48b67b1878b2.png)

MINECRAFT OPTION: 

![Minecraft option in survival](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbc447706226400b983806e7259c533cf57578bb.png)

**Commands**
- /musiclist **->** Sends a message showing all the music that are in the mod and the command.
- /musicstop **->** Stop all the songs.
- /music (song) **->** The command to play songs

**Music list**
